item.firecontrolcompat.loitering_munitio: Enter the missile view after launch to steer it manually
10 second flight time, slower than the television-guided missile
0.8x the warhead power of the anti-tank missile
item.firecontrolcompat.heavy_air_defense: Loads only into vertical launch silos
Lock, launch and proximity range are controlled by the fire control computer / connected display
Proximity fuse covers Sable structures and compat munitions
Twice the warhead power of the ground cruise missile
Loads only into AA missile launchers
No lock required; auto-searches a 60 degree cone after launch
Tracks Sable structures, compat missiles and countermeasures
5s acceleration to a top speed of 340 blocks/s (Mach 1), 45G overload
tooltip.firecontrolcompat.sap_round: Semi-armour-piercing: bursts inside once it is through the plate.
tooltip.firecontrolcompat.atgm_round: Gun-launched missile: a fire control computer can take it over and guide it all the way in.
tooltip.firecontrolcompat.sfm_round: Sensor-fuzed round: releases submunitions over the target to hunt the top armour.
tooltip.firecontrolcompat.sfm_submunitio: Sensor-fuzed submunition: falls from above, scans, then strikes the roof with a self-forging slug.
tooltip.firecontrolcompat.traffic_cone_r: Traffic cone round: puts a road cone through someone's armour.
tooltip.firecontrolcompat.traffic_cone_w: (!) Recommended only in a creative-mode single-player world.
(!) Using it in PVP tends to arrange a fight away from the keyboard.
gui.firecontrolcompat.eye_settings_hint: Press Done to write these onto the computer
task.firecontrolcompat.ammo_loader.desc: Carries rounds between the ammunition store and the launcher written on the loading table: one round per trip from the store to the launcher; a round the launcher refuses is carried back and earns the player a punch
task.firecontrolcompat.fire_control_oper: Sits on a seat bound to a fire control computer and works it: friend-or-foe marks are respected, hostile or unknown radar contacts are engaged (incoming ordnance first) and the bound bearings and weapons follow

Sits on a seat bound to a fire control computer and still intercepts incoming ordnance first, but never picks a structure on her own: she only engages what a player marked with a scoped spyglass (left click a structure to mark it, left click at nothing to drop the mark)
gui.firecontrolcompat.yuushya_cannon_typ: Cannon Type: Nethersteel Big Cannon Barrel
Use this entity block as a cannon barrel, switching between the nethersteel medium barrel and the big cannon barrel
item.firecontrolcompat.wire_guided_torpe: Wire-guided: the source on the line the shot was aimed down is taken at the launch, and the run goes for that one and nothing else.
A source that goes quiet leaves it nothing to steer on: the run scuttles itself. Sixty seconds of fuel; it needs a fuze before it will burst.
Passive homing: once it is in the water it runs at the loudest source it hears, the same water the sonar sets listen to.
Sixty seconds of fuel; it needs a fuze before it will burst.
item.firecontrolcompat.airdropped_acoust: Passive homing: dropped from a Mianbao rack; in the water it runs at the loudest source it hears.
item.firecontrolcompat.emp_shell.desc: Harmless to terrain: the burst shuts down fire control radars and Mianbao active protection within 72 blocks for 10 seconds
message.firecontrolcompat.sonar.connecte: Sonar wired to the fire control computer
message.firecontrolcompat.sonar.selectio: Sonar connection cancelled: no set there
message.firecontrolcompat.sonar.status_b: Sonar: wired to a fire control computer
message.firecontrolcompat.sonar.status_u: Sonar: not wired (wrench the computer first, then the sonar)
message.firecontrolcompat.sonar.need_con: Wrench the fire control computer first, then the sonar
message.firecontrolcompat.torpedo.need_c: Wrench the fire control computer first, then the torpedo tube
message.firecontrolcompat.torpedo.connec: Torpedo tube wired to the fire control computer
message.firecontrolcompat.torpedo.cleare: Torpedo tube unwired from its fire control computer
message.firecontrolcompat.torpedo.select: That fire control computer is gone
gui.firecontrolcompat.torpedo_hint: The round swims this far out of the tube before its hydrophones come on.
gui.firecontrolcompat.torpedo_note: Every acoustic torpedo this computer fires swims by these; each computer keeps its own.
gui.firecontrolcompat.select_hint_freque: Hold the item and press a frequency, the same as the computer's own link buttons.
gui.firecontrolcompat.select_hint_key: Press the button, then the key on the controller you want.
gui.firecontrolcompat.select_hint_pick: Any of the three makes the set pick the source nearest your sight line.
message.firecontrolcompat.select_press_n: Press the key on the ordinary remote controller you want (ESC cancels)
message.firecontrolcompat.select_press_a: Press the key on the advanced remote controller you want (ESC cancels)
message.firecontrolcompat.sonar.lock_non: Nothing on the sight line to lock
item.firecontrolcompat.torpedo_decoy.des: Loaded and thrown by the anti-infantry grenade launcher: it starts singing a second after it lands
item.firecontrolcompat.torpedo_decoy.lur: Homing torpedoes turn onto the noise and a warden comes to look; it carries no charge
block.firecontrolcompat.silencer.desc: Swallows the noise made against it, and one walled in with tiles is never heard either: sculk sensors, shriekers, the warden and listening sonar sets all stay quiet
block.firecontrolcompat.silencer.hint: Each tile an active ping echoes back through halves the range it is picked up at, to an eighth at most
message.firecontrolcompat.sonar.manporta: Man-portable sonar: nothing on the water
Man-portable sonar: %s source(s) on the water
item.firecontrolcompat.neva_missile.desc: Placed directly as the missile block itself
The fire control computer binds the block directly and owns lock and launch
Guidance matches fire control's own high-speed AA missile
Far more warhead power than the heavy air defense missile
message.firecontrolcompat.neva_ready: Neva missile in place - bind it with the fire control computer and fire directly
item.firecontrolcompat.strike_terminal.d: Right click a fire control computer to bind
Right click to open the chart, left click to mark, right click to clear
Mark a point, then the fire key sends the bound racks at it
gui.firecontrolcompat.strike_hint: Left click marks - right click clears - scroll zooms
message.firecontrolcompat.strike_bound: Bound to the fire control computer
message.firecontrolcompat.strike_unbound: Not bound yet: right click a fire control computer first
message.firecontrolcompat.laser_code_no_: No fire control computer within 32 blocks
sableblueprintexporter.page.hint: Bakes the selected blueprint through the game's own model pipeline and writes OBJ + MTL into sable_export/. Select a blueprint on the left, then press the export button.
message.firecontrolcompat.select_press_w: Press the key on the full-keyboard wireless controller you want (ESC cancels)
message.firecontrolcompat.select_redston: The wireless signal in hand is bound to the sonar (click again empty-handed to clear)
item.firecontrolcompat.ir_atgm.descripti: Infrared anti-tank missile: top attack, one round through the roof of a main battle tank
Loading: right-click a Mianbao anti-tank launcher (six ground mounts / the airborne rack); 2-4 rounds each
Use: lock the target with the optical lock, a pod laser or the radar, then fire from the fire control computer
Straight flight inside 100 blocks, otherwise a 26-block climb into a top-attack dive; lock range 1000 blocks
tooltip.firecontrolcompat.sonar: Sonar: listens for sources under the water and hands them to the fire control computer
tooltip.firecontrolcompat.sonar_hint: Wrench the fire control computer first, then the sonar, to wire it; the settings page sets range, angle and mode
tooltip.firecontrolcompat.manportable_so: Man-portable sonar: hold it to listen to the water around you
Works from the hand with no computer wired; it only hears targets in the water
